raster_style.method: Source chromatic-fill median versus actual cream bitmap background median (channels >220), not the coal plate behind the opaque bitmap. Minimum of the lock outer black runs at original y=360 scaled by verified CSS contain height.

evidence.area_method: Full viewport denominator; current seg1b bounding boxes. Background/border paint and resampled RGBA motif alpha masks; exclude hollow-node interiors and contain letterboxing. SVG routes/brackets sampled at <=1 source px; stroke width rounded up to device pixels. All positive-alpha UI counted in overlap; only alpha=1 subtracted from visible terrain. Whole landmark boxes used for stricter core test.

replaced_thresholds.route.walked_alpha / route.unwalked_alph: CSS alpha cannot establish visibility over illustration; replaced by rendered along-path contrast.
replaced_thresholds.complete.check_size / controls.icon_size: Round 3 explicitly enlarges bitmap motifs; 58px image box, lock minimum black run 1.5?2.4px. Previous 16/22px boxes cannot satisfy that requirement.
